entities.note: 4x4 colour-14 block with one black(0) edge row marking the side it faces, at rows 48-51, cols 32-35 (facing up, directly below the middle crate); moves on a 4-px lattice

4x4 crates: colour-4 border with a 2x2 colour-9 centre, at rows 24-27 cols 44-47, rows 28-31 cols 16-19 and rows 36-39 cols 32-35; the border colour is a state: 4 idle, 3 when directly in front of the player (grabbable), 0 while held
12x4 frame at rows 28-31, cols 28-39: colour-9 border, colour-2 interior; exactly three crate-widths wide (lattice cells at cols 28, 32, 36); crates and the player can walk over it
colour-1 field on a 4-px lattice; the screen edge is impassable; no walls or spikes at L1
row 63: colour 7 = remaining steps, colour 4 fills in from the RIGHT (64 px = 200 actions, about 0.3 px per action); every action costs 1

rules.note: player moves 4 px up if the cell is free; costs 1 step (ACTION2 down, ACTION3 left, ACTION4 right)
when not holding a crate the black edge row turns to the pressed direction FIRST, even if the move is then blocked (a blocked press is a pure turn); same for ACTION2/3/4
a move into a crate or off the screen edge is refused (only the turn happens); the step is still spent; same for ACTION2/3/4
after every action the crate directly in front of the player gets a colour-3 border (grabbable), a held crate a black border, all others colour 4

while holding, the player and the crate move together 4 px in ANY of the 4 directions keeping their offset (drag, pull or side-step); the player does not turn; refused if either destination cell is occupied; same for ACTION2/3/4
grab: the crate in the cell the player faces (border 3) becomes held (border turns black) and will move with the player; costs 1 step
release: a held crate is dropped where it is (border back to 3, then 4 once the player turns away); costs 1 step
with nothing in front and nothing held, ACTION5 only spends a step

goal.note: all three crates must occupy the three cells of the colour-9 pen (rows 28-31, cols 28-31 / 32-35 / 36-39, which they cover exactly) and none may be held; checked after every action; 26 actions minimum, 200 budget
